definition: A short identifier for a stratifier, used when emitting per-stratum rates (for example, 'by-sex', 'by-age-band').

The IANA media type identifying the language of a criteria expression: application/sql, application/vtl, text/cql, text/fhirpath. PublicSchema pins the media type so consumers know which engine to invoke; it does not pick a winner.

A criteria expression in the language identified by the paired language slot. May be inline source code or a reference of the form @ref:LibraryName.Symbol resolved against the calculation's libraries list.
Nested stratifiers that compose with their parent (for example, by-sex-and-age nests inside by-sex).
